Sydney pedestrian flows

Estimated weekday walking volumes on 13,291 sidewalk links. Demand model transferred from Brisbane, routed over up to 10 paths per trip from 5 points per SA1. Demand is first scaled by one citywide factor, then calibrated to City of Sydney pedestrian counts (autumn 2025).
